dedupe_keys.name: germany and spain municipal energy consumption and emissions 2022

description: Forschungszentrum Jülich publishes local-administrative estimates of final energy consumption and greenhouse-gas emissions for Germany and Spain in 2022. The Zenodo package separates consumption and emissions by end-use sectors including industry, transport, agriculture, households and commerce. The descriptor says CSV tables include regional codes, values and confidence levels. The public deposit is free under CC BY 4.0. It can support municipal energy-demand and emissions scenarios, with model-pypsa-eur providing a related energy-system planning context. A caveat is that local values are spatially disaggregated from broader totals, not metered municipal energy balances. Proxy selection and missing-value imputation affect confidence and may vary across sectors or countries. The own metadata and package identity were checked without opening CSV rows. Analysts should retain the confidence field and compare estimates with local statistics before using them as calibration truth.
